subject.title: feat(workboard): clarify proof provenance and diagnostics

question: Should Workboard permanently expose `independently_verified` as caller-declared metadata while explicitly declining to attest that verification itself?
rationale: This is a user-visible and persisted shared-contract choice about what Workboard authority a provenance label conveys; correctness tests cannot determine the intended product semantics.

options.title: Accept caller-declared provenance
options.body: Keep both provenance values, retain the explicit non-attestation wording, and rebase with focused upgrade coverage.

options.title: Use only worker-reported evidence
options.body: Remove the independently-verified value and keep Workboard proof metadata limited to evidence reported by the executing worker.

options.title: Design an attested verification flow
options.body: Defer this PR until maintainers define a verifier identity and evidence-validation contract rather than accepting a caller label.

recommendation.title: Accept caller-declared provenance
recommendation.body: Keep both provenance values, retain the explicit non-attestation wording, and rebase with focused upgrade coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor supplied the active and related Workboard proposals, but a current-main feature owner could not be established from the available evidence.
